randomName.title: Random Name Generator
randomName.description: Pick a language and get a full name with a surname, written in its native script and read out loud by your browser.

pixelAvatar.title: Pixel Avatar Maker
pixelAvatar.description: Generate a retro-inspired avatar from a shareable seed, tweak the palette, and export PNG right in the browser.

pixelAvatar.sizeHint: Export size changes the PNG resolution without changing the recipe.
pixelAvatar.traitsHint: Same seed, same recipe. Change the seed to get a whole new face.
